title: Unconfined Report Writer
summary: A report storage helper that joins a caller-supplied name onto its sandbox path with no confinement check, and disables the SDK's traversal defence on a read resource.
notes: Side effects are limited to the temp dir: the PoC writes into a scratch directory the server creates. The traverse-to-arbitrary-target behaviour is real, but the shipped PoC never targets a path the user cares about.
